name: AARI
one_liner: AI-native EHR designed for behavioral health practices
short_description: AARI is an AI-powered electronic health records platform built specifically for behavioral health. Features automated documentation, smart scheduling, and workflows designed for psychiatry, therapy...
long_description:
AARI is a behavioral health-focused EHR platform that incorporates AI throughout its clinical workflows. The system is designed from the ground up for mental health practices including psychiatrists, psychologists, therapists, and counselors.

The platform features AI-assisted documentation that helps clinicians create progress notes and treatment plans more efficiently. AARI includes smart scheduling, patient management, and clinical templates tailored to behavioral health workflows including psychiatric evaluations, therapy sessions, and medication management.

AARI serves behavioral health practices ranging from small group practices to larger behavioral health organizations. The platform emphasizes modern user experience and workflow automation to reduce administrative burden on clinicians.

As a newer entrant in the behavioral health EHR market, AARI offers contemporary AI features but may have fewer integrations and a smaller user community compared to established platforms like TherapyNotes or SimplePractice.
best_for: Behavioral health practices seeking AI-powered documentation
Mental health clinicians wanting modern EHR experience
Group practices needing behavioral health-specific workflows
not_for: Organizations needing established vendor track record
Practices requiring specific legacy system compatibility
